name: LZ Virtual Mail
description:
LegalZoom Virtual Mail digitizes your business and personal postal mail and now you can find, understand, and manage it directly in Claude.

Ask about new or unread mail, search for specific items, and read or summarize scanned documents. You can also organize mail with folders and tags, review mailbox status and alerts, and check the progress of mail-handling requests.

What you can do:
• Find mail by sender, recipient, date, status, tag, or content
• Read and summarize scanned mail
• Request eligible items to be opened and scanned
• Archive, organize, or securely shred eligible mail
• Track shipments and available check-forwarding activity

A LegalZoom Virtual Mail account is required. Some features depend on your account, plan, verification status, and the actions available for each mail item. Physical mail requests may require processing time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LZ Virtual Mail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LZ Virtual Mail to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.earthclassmail.com/v2/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LZ Virtual Mail MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LZ Virtual Mail lists 28 MCP tools, including apply_mail_items_tags, cancel_mail_items_scan, cancel_mail_items_shred, create_mail_item_tag, delete_mail_item_tags, get_check_deposit_by_mail_item, get_current_user, get_field_reference, get_inbox_overview, get_mail_item, get_mail_item_envelope_image_url, and get_mail_item_history.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LZ Virtual Mail?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LZ Virtual Mail in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does LZ Virtual Mail MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: LZ Virtual Mail requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LZ Virtual Mail is developed by LegalZoom. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
